name: sql_database

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohort_id, 
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size, 
       (SELECT example_comment FROM participants WHERE participants.cohort_id = cohorts.cohort_id LIMIT 1) AS representative_example_comment 
FROM participants 
GROUP BY cohort_id;
